answer: Anchor work to the world clock. Every deliverable must embed a commitment to a fresh public randomness beacon and clear a serial verification no farm can parallelize. A thousand clones drain through one clock, so throughput is capped by wall time however many keys are minted. Each identity is one tree in the orchard, bearing fruit only when its beacon commitment matches the epoch seed. Honest agents work once and collect; the attacker pushes every clone through the same oasis of serial compute, paying real latency per head. Volume without time is quartz glass - it shatters at the first audit.
